findings.title: Duplicated severity list can diverge unnoticed
findings.scenario: The severity list is now spelled out in both the publisher and the path matcher, so the next severity added to the protocol has to be edited in two files.
findings.consequence: A future severity silently fails validation in one of the two copies and the finding is dropped from publication.
findings.action: Read the allowed severities from one shared source and cover the mismatch with a test.
findings.explanation: Duplicated severity lists diverge quietly because neither copy fails when the other changes.
